lastCommit.subject: Adopt element-by-element UI ticks; fix the three things a glance missed

current.summary: Ran Phase 0's gate on everything built since 2026-08-20, both halves, and made it a runnable script. Paired a Galaxy S24 over wireless adb and closed Phase 1: both biometric branches, a real prompt, a real fingerprint reopening a locked session. Specified the permission surface and built Phase 3.5 after finding dark mode was finished and unreachable. Then adopted element-by-element UI ticks after a whole-screen review passed a flat-white wordmark that was plainly visible; the first tick found three departures on one screen. 254 tests to 305.
current.state: Phases 0-3.5 complete and seen rendered on a handset in both modes; biometrics verified end to end; dark mode reachable; no backend; four brand cuts still over the fetch cap
decisions: 'Medium haptic' is a strength the app deliberately does not have. Haptics names three uses and no strengths, so ACCEPTED and COMPLETED fire decision() - whose own definition is these two moments under their other name. No fourth haptic was added

The empty-room rule wins over demo completeness: all three bookingCompleted loop pairs point at thin categories, so that placement cannot be photographed and making it reachable would mean fabricating supply
No new colour was invented to fix contrast - controlOutline carries textMuted's existing value, because a hex the design never specified trades one silent drift for another
divider is pinned to stay UNDER 3:1: darkening the hairline would give every card a visible border and undo the design's shadow-not-borders treatment

The gate reaches screens by overriding routerProvider, not by tapping through the app - a gate that must complete a nine-step journey to photograph the ninth screen fails at step two and shows nothing
Every animation is gated on having arrived. Motion explains a change; one that fires when nothing happened is decoration
A picture is copy: the unlock hero glyph was the only element not obeying the no-sensor rule - 50dp of fingerprint over 'Use your device passcode to continue'
The gate must override what main() overrides or it photographs stubs. The session store is the deliberate exception - a prefs-backed one would carry a shot's session into the next

A special permission cannot be set early and defaulted on: SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW has no API to grant it and declaring it before the feature exists is a Play Store liability. Keep-screen-on is the opposite - no permission at all, so the preference was front-loaded

Notifications stay off the Preferences screen despite the canvas putting them there - they are consent records under FR-1.10 and splitting one DPA trail across two stores to save a phase would be the wrong shortcut
A UI tick is earned per element, not per screen - enumerate the artboard first or the screenshot decides what gets checked. Adopted after a glance passed a visible defect
A seam's fake must be more permissive than the real thing, never less, so no test can pass because the fake rejected what production would allow

Launch OTP on Firebase Auth phone rather than an aggregator - the free quota covers early volume and it skips a commercial negotiation that is a lead-time item. WhatsApp is the lever worth pushing hardest in Botswana, and the app already collects consent for it
working: Phase 0 closed on everything up to 2026-08-21: 28 screens compared against the canvas in both modes, palette holds on every surface, plate, chip and gradient
The booking state change moves as one event - chip plate, dot, label ink, accent rule and six step bars on one duration passed down rather than repeated. Endings are instant
The wallet balance counts on change and does nothing on load, enforced structurally
The three invisible controls are visible, confirmed on device after the fix

The biometric path is verified end to end on a Galaxy S24: both availability branches, a real system prompt, and a real fingerprint carrying a locked session back to active with the same name on the far side
The rentals to movers handoff sheet has been seen rendered for the first time
305 tests, flutter analyze clean, the gate runs green across 58 shots on emulator and handset
Dark mode is reachable - Phase 3.5 shipped the settings spine, so the theme can be changed from inside the app and survives a restart
notWorking: Profile photos do not exist anywhere in the design - the Account artboard renders initials and that fallback is the only state drawn. First entry in design/CORRECTIONS.md
No backend: a sent request never becomes a booking, a review is dropped, DemoOtpVerifier accepts any four digits, ten of eleven booking actions are inert
Three brand cuts and one logo still exceed the 256 KiB fetch cap - the dark ones compress larger than the light ones, which all landed
No picker behind the booking request's WHEN card - scheduling granularity still open
The loop prompt's completed-booking placement renders nowhere in the demo, correctly
Nothing reads keepScreenOnDuringRides yet - stored and defaulting on; the ride screens are Phase 5. Deliberate, not an oversight
The splash has no logo - the artboard stacks mark-dark.png at 88px above the wordmark and the build renders the type stand-in and no pin. Sharpest cost of the fetch-cap blocker
The OTP tests do not test OTP: DemoOtpVerifier accepts any four digits, so the rules around the code are tested and the code is not. Every stub is now tabled in test-strategy.md
Only the splash has had a real element-by-element UI tick. The other 28 screens have been looked at, which is explicitly not the same thing
doNotRepeat: A sleeping screen kills an on-device gate and names nothing useful: PixelCopy throws "Window doesn't have a backing surface!", the app takes SIGKILL, the driver says "Service has disappeared". NO screenshots survive - the driver flushes at the end. 'adb shell svc power stayon true' only holds while charging
A widget test pumping a screen needs AppTheme, not a bare MaterialApp - the palette is a ThemeExtension and context.palette throws a null check without it

An AnimatedSwitcher's outgoing child animates on the controller it was built with. Flipping duration from zero to 300ms at the change leaves the outgoing half at zero so it vanishes instead of crossfading - and every property assertion still passes. Instantness must come from unmounting the switcher
'Has it changed' is not 'is it different from where it started' - gating on state.key != _openedAt reads as not-arrived for any return to a prior state. It is a latch
A second pumpWidget in one test reuses the element tree, so the screen still reports having arrived. Split the test
find.byType(AnimatedDefaultTextStyle) finds Material's own - anchor finders to the widget you mean with find.ancestor(of: find.text(...))
Do not crossfade the chip's word: 'chip crossfades pending to ok' names BookingTones

Carried: a heredoc for a large Dart file dies with unexpected EOF (use Write); bulk string-replacing call shapes changes arity; a policy written only into the shipping store while tests run against the in-memory one; local_auth 3.x is not 2.x; stripping <script> when flattening a canvas; transcribing a binary out of a tool result; Get-Content on a source file; CrossAxisAlignment.stretch on a Row inside a ListView; a modal on a tab's Navigator; a here-string for git commit -m

lastCommit.subject: Build the booking status screen: all eleven states

archive.summary: Read the design properly and repaired everything built on a partial reading of it. Five rounds of user pushback, each correct: the design project was reachable all along; only one canvas of five had been read; docs must precede Dart; wrong documentation is an emergency because everything downstream inherits it; and the flattener was stripping <script>, which is where the design keeps PAL, CATS, REQUIREMENTS and all eleven BSTATES. Brand imported and shipped - launcher, adaptive, splash and notification icons all real and verified on device. Colour and type verified against the canvas rather than assumed. Booking status built with all eleven states.

Followed docs/build-order.md rather than re-deriving it. Closed Phase 0 by running all five built screens on a Pixel 9a in both modes - the first time this app has been seen rendered. The palette came back exact; the supply count was ellipsised and is fixed. The run exposed that the app has no identity at all, raised by the user mid-session: stock Flutter icon, white cold-start flash, no mark. Fixed what needed no artwork, made the rest an enforced artifact. Then built Phase 1 in full: seven entry routes plus the auth gate, with the entry rules held as states in core/session.dart. 147 tests.
